column1: # The Dynamic Button icon packs: one picture per row, the same subjects in each pack.
# state: on, off, alert or none. tile: the Material Design Icons glyph on the Classic Tile.
# modern: a glyph (lib:name), battery:<level>[:charging|:low], or frame:<lib>:<name> for a sensor.
# device: the glyph the Classic Device art is drawn from, or ours when it is drawn by hand.
# Rebuild the tab with tools/icon_packs.py after editing; tools/icon_packs.py fetch adds new glyphs.
